haikus.haiku:
Ink glows on panels
Heroes leap with comic hearts
Pages flutter, joy
Happy #NationalComicBookDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Red shells glow bright soft
Sea breeze carries sweet warm salt
Crustacean feast calls
Happy #NationalLobsterDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Gentle candle glow
Pages turn like soft rain near
Stories breathe warm light
#HappyBirthdayWilliamFaulkner from @ClamBakeSanta

Melody drifts, soft
Bright chords dance on air and light
Joy sings, heart bright now
#HappyBirthdayDmitriShostakovich from @ClamBakeSanta
